之前我就嫌这份600DPI的清晰度不行了，所以这次，我买了一台二手的、2004年产的、原生1200DPI的 EPSON Perfection 1270描仪，用来重新扫描这份画集。（空白页不扫描了）
现在，我终于可以更清晰地欣赏Snowmi 老师可爱的画风了，所以我要把这份喜悦分享给你们。

I had been dissatisfied with the 600DPI clarity before, so this time I bought a second-hand, 2004-manufactured, native 1200DPI EPSON Perfection 1270 scanner to rescan this artbook. (Skipping the blank pages.)
Now I can finally appreciate Snowmi's adorable art style in much clearer detail, so I wanted to share this joy with all of you.
